artworks.title: Soldier's Family Encamped
artworks.description: The image shows three figures seated closely together in front of a rustic makeshift shelter made of branches and fabric. The figure on the left is a woman covered with a hooded cloak. Next to her is a man with his arm around a young child. The child is facing the man and wearing a fur-lined coat. The background includes a rough stone wall, a horse, a large tree trunk, and leafless trees.

artworks.title: Mon Caporal, Je n'ai pu avons que ça
artworks.description: The image shows a humorous military scene with four military figures in animated discussion. One figure on the right is presenting a birdcage to the other three figures on the left. In the background, a partially ruined building is visible, along with additional soldiers in the distance.

artworks.title: Mon Caporal, je n'ai pu avons que ça
artworks.description: In the image, there are men in military uniforms sitting and standing in a sketch-like illustration. The seated men are pointing and laughing at the soldier holding a birdcage. The men wear military-style uniforms with hats on the ground. The standing man wears a tall, ornate military cap and a long coat, holding a small birdcage. The background includes outlines of damaged buildings and other figures. The setting seems to be outdoors, possibly a battlefield.

artworks.title: Gredin de Sort!...
artworks.medium: lithograph touched with wash on wove paper [proof?]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier lying against a tree amidst a battle. The soldier is in a prone position with his back against a tree, appearing to be resting or injured. A rifle lies on the ground beside him. In the background, groups of soldiers march in unison with rifles, their figures rendered in a softer focus. Clouds of smoke and fire suggest active battle scenes, adding a dramatic tension to the composition. The detailed shading, posture, and expression capture a sense of wartime fatigue or injury.

artworks.title: Gredin de Sort!...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man leaning against a tree in a war setting. The scene features a man sitting under a large tree, dressed in attire that suggests a military uniform or soldier's outfit, complete with a hat, belt, and boots. Next to the figure is a long rifle lying on the ground. The background reveals a group of soldiers marching with rifles, partially shrouded in a misty or smoky atmosphere. The entire composition is rendered in monochrome, with detailed cross-hatching to provide depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: M. Pochez
artworks.description: The sketch shows a man standing with one hand on his hip and the other hand holding a hat. He has a beard, mustache, and wavy hair, and is wearing a long coat, trousers, vest, and a bow tie. He is in an upright posture. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated or turned slightly, with a content expression. He has a full beard, mustache, and prominent cheeks. His hair is short and neatly combed with some texture. He is dressed formally in a jacket with wide lapels and a bow tie or scarf. The jacket has decorative elements including a visible button and a small pin or ribbon on the lapel. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Rape of Europa
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person interacting with a bull. The drawing features a figure embracing a bull with notable horns. The line work is delicate and the outlines are finely detailed, particularly around the figure’s hair and the bull's face. The bull is depicted with human-like eyes and ears as it lays on a bed of swirling shapes. The figure appears intertwined with the bull, with draped cloth flowing around them. The left hand of the figure holds the side of the bull’s face, while the rest of the body lies on the bull's back. The style is reminiscent of classical drawings with a mythological or allegorical theme.

artworks.title: Vallée de Lanterbrunen
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a man under a large tree holding a staff in the center. A wooden structure with a person leaning on the balcony is on the right. Fine brushstrokes create textures in the foliage, stonework, and clothing, giving a realistic style. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing tones for shadows and highlights. In the distance, rocky cliffs and a waterfall contrast with lush vegetation.

artworks.title: Mt. Sinai
artworks.description: The image depicts a fortified structure amidst high mountains. The structure is a blend of solid geometric forms, rounded towers, and a dome, partially obscured by rocks. The artwork features precise brushstrokes in a lithographic style, contrasting the rocky landscape with softer shading on the architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic in earthy grays and browns. Various figures in traditional dress are present within the scene.

artworks.title: Classical Landscape
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in black and brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a monument featuring an arched opening and a statue inside. The background shows hills or mountains, a sky with clouds, and a river or body of water. The artwork has detailed trees and statues, with a sepia color palette. Steps lead to the monument, where several figures are gathered.

artworks.title: Galerie latérale d'un temple de Pestum
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with large, fluted columns dominating the view. An intricate entablature is supported by detailed capitals on top of the columns. In the center left, a seated figure is present. The horizon is obscured by the structure, but a glimpse of open space can be seen through the colonnade in the background. The style is detailed with fine lines, giving the impression of a classical engraving or etching. The color scheme is monochromatic with muted grays and soft sepias, enhancing the grandeur of the architectural elements against the light background.

artworks.title: Colossus L'Apenin, Pratolino
artworks.description: The image depicts a large statue resembling a bearded man in rocky terrain. The statue is partially kneeling and leaning on one arm, with cascading water flowing into a pool nearby. Trees in the background frame the sculpture. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, complementing the serene environment. The scene has a monochromatic palette with shades of sepia. Small human figures offer scale to the statue, and trees form a backdrop.

artworks.title: Young Woman with Long Hair
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper body, focusing on her face and shoulders. She is slightly turned to the side, with her head tilted. She has long, flowing dark hair and is wearing a draped red garment that covers her left shoulder. The background is a hazy swirling mix of yellow and brown. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Couple Standing in Water
artworks.medium: etching printed in red on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a body of water surrounded by water lilies and tall grass. One figure is fully nude, standing with their back to the viewer, holding the other figure who is partially draped in a cloth. The second individual is leaning backward with their head slightly inclined, featuring softly defined facial features and loosely drawn back hair. In the background, there are outlines of a landscape with hills in the distance and more foliage along the water's edge.

artworks.title: A Family (Une famille)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three children grouped closely together. The foreground child has their face in profile with straight, shoulder-length hair. Another child is partially visible with short hair and a focused gaze. A third child with short hair is seen in profile with eyes closed. The group is separated by shadows, with a silhouette resembling a doll or picture nearby. The background has a dark crosshatch pattern.

artworks.title: Nude Girl Combing Her Hair
artworks.medium: etching with roulette on wove paper
artworks.description: This print shows a depiction of a woman's upper body from her head down to just above her knees. She is standing with both arms raised and bent at the elbows and her hands placed on her head, seemingly adjusting her long, dark hair, which flows down past her shoulders. She has pale skin, and her facial features are drawn in with simple lines. She is nude, although her hair covers much of her chest and torso. The background is filled with a textured, cross-hatched pattern. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Maternity
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted ethereally, focusing on the upper body and head. The person is in profile, facing the right side with a raised hand and softly defined facial features. The hair is depicted with delicate, flowing lines, and the clothing blends seamlessly with the figure. The background is monochromatic and lacks discernible details or objects, creating a sense of mystery and movement.

artworks.title: Waltz of the Blonde and Waltz of the Brunette
artworks.medium: colored lithograph printed in orange on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows four elegantly dressed individuals dancing in a social setting. On the left, a woman with a styled updo adorned with a floral hairpiece is dancing with a man. She wears a dark, flowing dress, gloves, and holds an unseen partner's hand. A decorative fan and some flowers are near her feet. On the right, a woman with long, wavy hair is dancing with another man. She wears a light-colored gown with floral embellishments, while the man is in a dark suit. Both dancers appear to hold each other as they move, with her arm around his shoulder. The background features other couples in muted tones, adding to the sense of a crowded ballroom. The entire scene is rendered in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Male Academy
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing with his legs crossed at the ankles, arms raised above his head with hands on top. The figure has a muscular build, with closed eyes, wavy hair, and is unclothed. In the background are cross-hatched lines creating a shadowy effect. To the left is a smaller sketch of an elderly man's head.

artworks.title: Grape Harvest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures engaging in grape pressing. The central scene depicts two figures with muscular builds, one of whom is adorned with a vine wreath around the head, pressing grapes with their feet in a large vat. Surrounding them are other characters engaged in various activities, such as one playing a musical instrument. The figures appear to be in a celebratory or ritualistic setting. The background includes additional figures and outlines of a landscape. The drawing captures detailed textures and energetic motion throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Henri Rochefort
artworks.description: The image features an illustration of a man's head and shoulders. The man is facing forward with his hand resting against his chin. He has a prominent forehead, thick eyebrows, deep-set eyes, full wavy hair, and a mustache. He is wearing a suit with a high-collared shirt and a bowtie. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Maison close (planche refusée) (Bordello) (refused plate)
artworks.description: Three individuals are seated at a table, shown from the waist up. The person on the left has their body turned slightly towards the other two. This person has dark, voluminous hair styled in an updo. The middle individual is angled towards the right, with lighter hair pulled back, possibly held in place by a headband. The third person is sitting to their right, wearing a cap. They are dressed similarly and appear engaged in the conversation. On the table, there is a glass, a bowl on a plate, and a spoon. The background consists of subtle outlines of walls and decor, possibly a mirror or window.

artworks.title: Un Pouilleux (Flea Seeker)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude male figure standing in a semi-turned position with his head bent forward. His face is obscured by his dark, disheveled hair. He holds a draped cloth with both hands. The background features diagonal lines that contrast with the smooth floor.
